notes.title: September Update Announcement
notes.notes:
In the September update, we have conducted comprehensive optimizations to the overall experience.



New Powerful Enemy: In the campaign, you will encounter a new formidable foe—Ymir-Kai. It will appear as an elite enemy. In future updates, you will have the chance to recruit it as an Ally unit.

Balance Optimizations: We have adjusted certain drones and chips that fellow pilots reported as unbalanced in terms of strength. They will return to the battlefield with a new look.

Battlefield Upgrades: In the new campaign, you can view more detailed node information, allowing you to dynamically plan your strategic route.



One more thing:



Ace Strategy: Mecha Nova is coming to Tokyo Game Show 2025!

📅 Date: September 25th - 28th, 2025
📍 Location: Makuhari Messe Hall 11, Indie Game Area
🛡️ Booth Number: 11-E76



Come try our mecha-themed roguelike deckbuilder and experience intense tactical battles firsthand! We can’t wait to meet you there!

notes.title: August Update Announcement
notes.notes:
Thank you for your patience! During the previous testing phase, we received a wealth of valuable feedback. To deliver a smoother gaming experience and higher-quality visuals, our team has been working tirelessly to refine and polish the game. This update primarily focuses on gameplay structure and balance adjustments. Details are as follows:


[olist]
Experience Improvements
[/olist]
Mechanic Adjustments: The old overlay mechanic has been upgraded into a new integration system, along with additional cards, to diversify deck-building strategies.

Balance Tweaks: Adjusted mission length and optimized certain card stats to improve battle pacing.

UX Enhancements: Improved in-game information display, with clearer explanations for Data Turbulence, Chips, and Mech Abilities, making the battlefield more intuitive.
[olist]
Visual Upgrades UI Revamp Plan: Still in progress!
[/olist]


“ACE Strategy: Mecha Nova” is a tactical roguelike deck building game. Recruit elite mecha pilots, deploy drones and cast commands. Master your ACE mechas while collecting unique cards and chips in battles, and form your own build for total battlefield dominance.

notes.title: Monthly Update - May
notes.notes:
ACE Strategy: Mecha Nova is a tactical roguelike deck building game. Recruit elite mecha pilots, deploy drones and cast commands. Master your ACE mechas while collecting unique cards and chips in battles, and form your own build for total battlefield dominance.

1. New Additions
● 9 New Enemy Stages: Face more complex tactical challenges.
● 25 New Cards: Double the card pool for expanded deck-building strategies!

2. Balance Adjustments
● Card tuning: Smoother power curve, reduced extreme high/low-roll scenarios.
● Stage difficulty refined: More forgiving early-game, fiercer late-game threats.

3. Visual Enhancements
● UI Overhaul: Streamlined layout for clearer combat feedback.
● Mech-Specific Effects: Added unique animations for enhanced card impact.

notes.title: Ace Strategy: Mecha Nova 0429 Update
notes.notes:
1. Gameplay
    ○ This month, we experimented with adding pilots to the deck and incorporated some background story of the world where the battles happen.
    ○ Due to time constraints, the story and pilot mechanics are not polished, but the addition of pilots seems to have enhanced the strategic fun in battles!
    ○ Dive in, enjoy, and share your feedback with us!

2. Content
   ● New Additions – Two new levels: "White Hole" and "Black Hole"
   ● Temporarily Removed – Player mech "Crux"
   ● New Mini-Campaign – Special Ops: "FIREFLY"

notes.title: April Release Incoming
notes.notes:
In addition to new player mechas, PvP is now in Beta!
Will you rise as an Ace Pilot, dominating the arena as a warrior feared by all?
Or will you first explore the uncharted stellar paths of deep space?
New version, limited invites—hurry and recommend it to your friends for a trial play!

What’s new
1. Optimized the level design of the campaign [Sector Exploration].
2. Adjusted the combat style of mecha ACE-001 WhiteDwarf and introduced two new ones: ACE-002 Crux and ACE-003 Orion.
3. in PvP mode, You can build your deck by completing PvE campaigns and battles against friends.
